lines.en: I walk along the maze walls.
I remember every fork.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在通道里来回撞。
lines.en: My steps bounce back and forth in the passage.

lines.zh: 我拐过第三个弯，继续走。
lines.en: I take the third turn and keep going.
I hug the wall and move slowly.
I have walked this path a thousand times.
My finger marks remain on the stone.
I walk along the damp floor.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到这里。
lines.en: I circle around and come back here.
I have crouched in every dead end.
I turn, and the passage is still the same one.
I look up; the roof is stone too.
I crouch in the shadow of a corner.
I hold still and wait for footsteps.
My fingers scrape slowly over the stone.
This maze has no end.

lines.zh: 我听见水在很远的地方滴。
lines.en: I hear water dripping far away.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，很快又抬起。
lines.en: I lower my head, then raise it again.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在通道里回响。
lines.en: My breathing echoes in the passage.
The light here never changes.

lines.zh: 迷宫的转角，我等了很多年。
lines.en: At the maze's corner, I have waited years.

lines.zh: 墙壁上的苔藓被我摸平了。
lines.en: The moss on the wall is smooth where I touch it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转动头，听四个方向。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, listening to four directions.
I have counted the forks again.

lines.zh: 身后那条路突然很安静。
lines.en: The path behind me has gone very quiet.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半面墙。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the wall.
You are lost. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 这条通道我走了很多年。
lines.en: I have walked this passage many years.
You went three rounds and came back here.
You think this is your first time?

lines.zh: 我的脚步声你可能听不见。
lines.en: You may not hear my footsteps.

lines.zh: 这里的岔口，走哪条都一样。
lines.en: At this fork, either way ends the same.
Your lamp is running low on oil.

lines.zh: 我在这条路上看了很多人。
lines.en: I have watched many people on this path.

lines.zh: 他们都在同一个地方停下。
lines.en: They all stopped at the same place.
Are you different?
My nails are long. Look.
You back up, and the path is gone.

lines.zh: 我站在你唯一的出口上。
lines.en: I stand in your only exit.
This place was not a maze before.
Your shadow is shorter than mine.
No hurry. The passages turn on their own.
Walk a little further and you will see.
I am waiting for you to choose.

lines.zh: 快点，另一边已经关上了。
lines.en: Hurry. The other side has closed.

lines.zh: 你听，有脚步声，不是你的。
lines.en: Listen — footsteps. Not yours.
I've walked these maze paths for years.
The stone scraped my hide open.

lines.zh: 石壁把我的声音弹回来两次。
lines.en: The stone walls bounce my voice back twice.
I press the wound and shift into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一下我从拐角退开了。
lines.en: That drove me back from the corner.
I crouch and wait for you to come near.
Blood is on the moss now.
I lean on the wall and breathe.

lines.zh: 苔藓上留下一道暗红，我退开。
lines.en: A dark red stain stays on the moss and I withdraw.
I can still move; the road is long.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，然后走开。
lines.en: Set it down, then walk away.
There is no food in this maze.
I put out a hand and withdraw it.
If you can find me, try.
Smells cannot disperse between stone walls.

lines.zh: 你举着它做什么，我在这条弯道等了多年。
lines.en: What are you raising? I have waited years at this bend.
I go around behind you to look.
These corridors need no offerings.

lines.zh: 你把它撒了，地上会有声。
lines.en: Spill it and it will make a sound.
I sit down and watch you.
In this passage there is no room to step back.
You have bumped into the maze itself.
My arm scrapes the stone.

lines.zh: 这条迷宫岔路，我走了很多年。
lines.en: I have walked this maze fork for years.
You are pressed back into the corner.

lines.zh: 这一碰让地面发出闷响。
lines.en: That contact produced a dull thud.
I turn sideways and leave a narrow gap.
My breath is right behind your ear.

lines.zh: 通道太窄了，我们贴着了。
lines.en: The passage is too narrow; we are touching.

lines.zh: 在这迷宫里转了太多年。
lines.en: Too many years turning through this maze.

lines.zh: 你想出去，可路一直转回来。
lines.en: You want out, but the path keeps turning back.
I will walk with you a while.
I wait for you at every fork.

lines.zh: 有时候我走前，有时候走后。
lines.en: Sometimes I go before, sometimes behind.
Lean on the wall and rest a moment.

lines.zh: 迷宫的每条岔路，我都走过。
lines.en: I have walked every fork of the maze.
There are only the two of us on this path.

lines.zh: 你听我的脚步，就能找到方向。
lines.en: Follow the sound of my steps and you may find the way.
The longer we wander, the better we know each other.
No hurry; we have a long way.
I pick it up from between the stones.
I wonder who dropped this.
I turn it over in my hand.
This is of no use in the maze.
I toss it into the dark.
Something is pressed under the stone.
I pry it up with a fingernail.
It rolled into the passage.

lines.zh: 这上面的味道我不认得。
lines.en: I do not know the smell on it.
I will keep it; perhaps it will be useful.

lines.zh: 你走进了我以为空的通道。
lines.en: You walked into a passage I thought empty.
I watch you from the corner ahead.
I have sealed this passage.
That sound was not the wind.
I am on the other side of the maze.
I know the path you chose.

lines.zh: 你拐错的每个弯，都通向我。
lines.en: Every wrong turn you take leads to me.
Raise the lamp; the path will look shorter.
You have come half the circle.
The stones here are listening.
I move on the count of ten.
You have stopped. Good.

lines.zh: 我们之间只有一条通道。
lines.en: Only one passage lies between us.
I took the long way around, and you did not notice.
I am at the corner behind you.

lines.zh: 这一次我不会再放你走。
lines.en: This time I will not let you go.
I follow along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 你每拐一次弯，我就近一点。
lines.en: Every turn you take brings me nearer.

lines.zh: 这条死路的墙，我摸了很多年。
lines.en: I have felt the walls of this dead end for many years.

lines.zh: 这条通道的尽头是死路。
lines.en: This passage ends in a dead end.
You are circling on the spot.
I hear you panting against the wall.
The stone walls swallow all sound.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，路会把你带来。
lines.en: I need not run; the path brings you to me.
You are shining the lamp the wrong way.

lines.zh: 岔口又多了一个，我在数。
lines.en: One more fork now; I am counting them.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地面比刚才湿。
lines.en: The floor under you is wetter than before.
My hands are coated in moss.
Behind the corner, I have been standing all along.

lines.zh: 你再走几步就到我这了。
lines.en: A few more steps and you are here.

lines.zh: 我屏住呼吸，通道就静了。
lines.en: I hold my breath, and the passage goes silent.
You stop to listen, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 这条路我闭着眼都走得完。
lines.en: I could walk this path with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 现在只剩最后一条岔口。
lines.en: Only one fork remains now.
There is a gap in the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你就听见了。
lines.en: One step forward, and you will hear me.
My hand comes around the corner.
The passage walls press inward at once.
I pin you against the stone.
Your lamp hits the floor and goes out.
That blow left no echo at all.

lines.zh: 拐角后面伸出的手，抓住了你。
lines.en: A hand from around the corner takes hold of you.

lines.zh: 你退后撞到了我的胸口。
lines.en: You backed into my chest.
The passage has suddenly narrowed.
You stepped on my hand.
I let go, and you run again.

lines.zh: 地面在脚下转了个方向。
lines.en: The ground turned under your feet.
I have waited here a long while.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声越来越近。
lines.en: The footsteps you hear are coming closer.

lines.zh: 我把你往岔口的另一边推。
lines.en: I push you toward the other side of the fork.
The light here has gone out.
The maze just changed a passage.

lines.zh: 我在这条迷宫里很多年了。
lines.en: I have been in this maze for many years.

lines.zh: 通道尽头多了一道影子。
lines.en: There is one more shadow at the passage's end.
I take my place at the corner.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声从墙后传来。
lines.en: My breathing comes from behind the wall.

lines.zh: 地面上的苔藓被我压过。
lines.en: I have pressed the moss on the floor.

lines.zh: 石壁上有一道新的指痕。
lines.en: There is a new fingermark on the stone.
The maze opened another fork.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从阴影里探出身子。
lines.en: I slowly lean out of the shadow.
The light here does not reach me.

lines.zh: 我听见你在另一个方向。
lines.en: I hear you somewhere else.
I come up from the deepest part.
The moss on the walls glistens with damp.

lines.zh: 你先看见了影子，再看见我。
lines.en: You saw the shadow first, then me.
There is finally someone in this passage.

lines.zh: 我在拐角后慢慢展开身体。
lines.en: I unfold myself slowly behind the corner.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，贴着地面。
lines.en: I lower myself close to the floor.
My nails drag along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 屋子里的回声多了一层。
lines.en: The echoes in the corridor gained another layer.
After such a wait, someone has come.
I press my hand to the wall and listen.

lines.zh: 火光把通道照亮，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: Firelight fills the passage. I hate that.

lines.zh: 我从岔口掉下去，摔在石上。
lines.en: I fell through a fork and hit stone.

lines.zh: 水在通道里涨起来，没有出口。
lines.en: Water rose in the passage, and there was no way out.

lines.zh: 石块被震落，砸在我背上。
lines.en: The blast shook stones loose onto my back.

lines.zh: 有东西钉在石壁和我之间。
lines.en: Something is pinned between the wall and me.

lines.zh: 有股力量让我的手脚发沉。
lines.en: A force has made my limbs heavy.

lines.zh: 我在迷宫里找不到吃的。
lines.en: I cannot find food in this maze.
Thunder bounces back and forth in the passage.

lines.zh: 地面塌了，我掉进更暗的地方。
lines.en: The floor gave way and I fell into deeper dark.
